       MIN(mi_idx.info) AS rating,
       MIN(t.title) AS complete_euro_dark_movie
FROM complete_cast AS cc,
     comp_cast_type AS cct1,
     comp_cast_type AS cct2,
     company_name AS cn,
     company_type AS ct,
     info_type AS it1,
     info_type AS it2,

     movie_keyword AS mk,

  AND cct2.kind != 'complete+verified'
